preregistered.transpilation: every iteration's computed_circuit carries the architecture with the sent phases (max |delta phi| mod 2 pi below 1e-9); a re-transpiled iteration voids the mesh comparison
preregistered.classes: phase noise: hot and cold meshes keep more light in the block than the compiled mesh; gain or crosstalk: the compiled mesh keeps more than the hot mesh; device state: the compiled bright mesh repeats the qpu:belenos job-04 counts (in_block 0.505 dark-corrected) or departs from them
preregistered.decision: the class with the highest efficiency-weighted multinomial log-likelihood over all settings selects the mesh form for the 84/84 box-kite placement
